entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: No dated central-bank meeting is in the freeze. The edge is a snapback off the one-year extreme, and it is exhausted if the cross extends through 0.8331.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: Euro-sterling lifts off the 0.8331 one-year extreme as the sterling premium versus the euro mean-reverts, with the dollar cancelled.

entry_rationale: Euro-sterling at 0.8331 isolates euro cheapness versus sterling and cancels the dollar.
entry_thesis: Buy 8 million euro-sterling. The cross is 0.8331, the bottom of its one-year range and near the bottom of five years, while oil at 86 and 93 is not a blow-off and copper at 5.976 is not a sterling impulse. Euro-sterling cancels the dollar, the 5.10 US ten-year, and cash funding, which a long euro or a short sterling would keep. Aussie-Canada stays shut on this oil tape, and Aussie-kiwi richness agrees with the kiwi's floor break.

invalidation: Close the long if euro-sterling extends through 0.8331 before any euro-positive impulse, or if a UK yield premium versus the euro-area ten-year at 3.35 explains the cheapness as carry.
